Main Case No: W.P.Nos.45049; 45059; 45067; 45074 & 45091 of 2017
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Date Order

O NO. 
 06 09.12.2024 NJS,J  In this batch of cases, the petitioners are  seeking the following relief:
 "....to issue a Writ, order or direction more  particularly one in the nature of writ of mandamus  declaring the action of the respondents more particularly the 4th respondent in issuing declarations (Part-I,II,III,IV) vide RC. No. 136/2016- G1 Dt. 01-12-2017 and 02-12-2017 declaring that the petitioners lands are required for public purpose for construction of Capital City rd Development Project by the 3 respondent and issuing notices to the petitioners and directing them to appear before the 5th respondent on 22- 01-2018 for award enquiry and for filing of objections on extents of lands as illegal, arbitrary, deprivation of Constitutional Right to Life as enunciated Under Article-19(1)(e) and Article-21 of The Constitution of India and violative of Article- 300A of The Constitution of India and contrary to the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and contrary to the provisions of The Andhra Pradesh Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Rules, 2014 and contrary to the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Social Impact Assessment and Consent) Rules, 2014 and consequently set aside the declarations (Part-I, II, III, IV) vide RC. No. 136/2016-G1 Dt. 01- 12-2017 and 02-12-2017 as the same is based on faulty, incorrect, precast and prefabricated Social Impact Assessment and direct the respondents to conduct fresh Social Impact Assessment Study of SL.

sentences.text:
1 counsel represented that Mr. Ponnavolu Sudhakara Reddy, the learned counsel for the petitioners,
has given up vakalath long back in the year 2019 itself and despite reminding the petitioners to make alternative arrangements they have not made alternative arrangements.
Be that as it may.

Pursuant to the order dated 04.12.2024, a Memo dated 09.12.2024 has been filed wherein it is inter alai stated as follows:
"It is humbly submitted that, on 04.12.2024, this Hon'ble Court directed the Counsel for petitioner to SL. DATE ORDER OFFICE NO. NOTE file memo regarding giving up Vakalath and about intimation being given to the petitioners about the listing of the Writ Petition.

It is further submitted that, I have issued the NOC (given up vakalat) in the year 2019, when I was appointed as Additional Advocate General for State of Andhra Pradesh and also, I intimated about listing of case to Meka Poorna Chandra Reddy (Petitioner No.6), who is leading all the writ petitioners."

When the matters are taken up for consideration today, one Mr.Meka Poorna Chandra Reddy, who is the 6th petitioner in W.P.No.45049 of 2017, appeared in person and stated that he received information about listing of the case yesterday i.e.,
on 08.12.2024.
Except him, none of the other petitioners appeared and there is no representation on their behalf.
Learned Advocate General reiterated his earlier submission that the Government is proposing to withdraw the Notifications under challenge and issue fresh Notifications.
Therefore, the validity or otherwise of the Notifications in question need not be adjudicated.
However, as the petitioners in the Writ Petitions are not represented by any counsel, list these matters on 30.12.2024 to enable them to make alternative arrangements, if any.

It is made clear that the interim orders granted on the earlier occasion would not come in the way of Government in issuing appropriate Notifications / proceedings with reference to the subject matter lands.
